options.metric: Annual sum of pedestrians killed in reported motor vehicle crashes
options.reason: A bar chart makes the number of fatalities in each discrete year easy to compare.
options.interpretation: This framing answers the annual-count question directly, and the bars make the differences in yearly totals readily comparable. It is defensible because the data records pedestrian fatalities by crash and year; it leaves causes and exposure-adjusted risk unanswered.

options.metric: Annual sum of pedestrians killed in reported motor vehicle crashes
options.reason: A line chart emphasizes how annual pedestrian fatality counts change over time.
options.interpretation: This framing answers the same annual-count question while showing the year-to-year path: the count declined from 176 in 2013 to 119 in 2025, with intervening rises and falls. A line is defensible for emphasizing temporal movement across consecutive years; it leaves causes and exposure-adjusted risk unanswered.
